name: jtbd-job-mapper
description: Turns customer research into a full Jobs-to-be-Done package — segments, a job list in When/Want-to/So-that form, a link graph and a Next Move Theory segment map (Ivan Zamesin's Advanced JTBD canon, not generic Christensen JTBD). Ships two skills that share the same engine and differ only in the final render: jtbd-research-to-figjam draws it on a FigJam board, jtbd-research-to-html renders one self-contained HTML file that opens in any browser.
